cpu.scope: STRATIFIED SAMPLES ONLY, not full-matrix acceptance
cpu.seed: np.random.default_rng(42+N); standard_normal((N,N), dtype=float32), A then B
cpu.selection: All unique historical worst coordinates; 256 smallest |NumPy FP32 output|; 256 seeded random positions with |NumPy output|>1, disjoint priority in that order
cpu.near_zero_definition: abs(FP64 dot)<=0.01; relative errors retained and explicitly labelled
cpu.ulp_definition: Distance in ordered binary32 representations to round32(FP64 dot), signed zero unified
cpu.fp64_method: NumPy dot of exact binary32-to-binary64 conversions; cross-check math.fsum of binary64 exact products

strategies.numpy_fp32: Original full NumPy FP32 matmul, 4 OpenBLAS threads
strategies.sequential_fma: libm.fmaf ascending K; one binary32 rounding per multiply-add
strategies.pairwise_fp32: Explicit binary32 products followed by adjacent balanced tree of binary32 adds
strategies.blocks: 32/64/128 ascending-K fmaf within each block, then binary32 balanced tree over partial sums
strategies.fp64_acc_fp32_out: Independent ascending-K binary64 product/add, one final binary32 conversion

gpu.full_matrix_comparisons: GPU methods versus each other and original NumPy FP32 only
